description: Look up an HTTP status code by number or keyword. Returns the reason phrase, description, category (1xx Informational, 2xx Success, 3xx Redirection, 4xx Client Error, 5xx Server Error), whether the code is cacheable by default, and the defining RFC with section reference. For keyword queries, returns the closest match plus alternatives.

query.description: Numeric status code (e.g., "404" or "422") or descriptive keyword (e.g., "not found", "too many requests", "unprocessable").

name: ref_http_status

alternatives.description: Other status codes that matched the keyword query. Present only for keyword searches with multiple matches.

items.description: An alternative HTTP status code that also matched.

cacheable.description: Whether this status code is cacheable by default per RFC 9110.

category.description: Status code category (1xx Informational, 2xx Success, 3xx Redirection, 4xx Client Error, 5xx Server Error).

description.description: Human-readable description of when and why this status is used.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No HTTP status code matched the query. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

rfc_section.description: RFC section number (e.g., "15.5.5"), or null if not applicable.

title: HTTP Status Code Lookup
